page.layout: One title page, all lines centred in one block: title and dedication lines, a printer's ornament below, then a rule and the printer's colophon.

main_text.l: S.S. Th. D. & Linguæ S. Locorum item
Ad D. 15. Mensf. Jan. An. M DC LIII.

page.notes: The handwritten "27" in the upper right corner is a later annotation and is left out. Faint show-through of text from the reverse page is left out. The "De" line is in a script face, transcribed as printed. "Decker" in the colophon is black letter. The ornament between the text and the rule is a printer's decoration, not text.
